create or alter function [dbo].[GetDisplayPath] ( @segments xml, @levelDelimiter nvarchar(50), @keyDelimiter nvarchar(50) ) returns nvarchar(850) WITH SCHEMABINDING as begin declare @path nvarchar(850)
if @segments is null begin set @path = '' end else begin select @path = string_agg(V, @levelDelimiter) from ( select string_agg(Val, @keyDelimiter) within group(order by P) as V from ( select X.p.value('./@level', 'int') as L, X.p.value('./@position', 'int') as P, X.p.value('.', 'nvarchar(250)') as Val from @segments.nodes('/path/segment') X(p) ) O group by L ) O
if @path is null begin set @path = '[ERROR:KEY_FIELDS_NULL]' end end
return @path end
